title: Assembly of electors at state capital; time.
bodyText: The electors chosen shall assemble at the state capital on the first Tuesday after the second Wednesday in December next following their election, at two o'clock in the afternoon.
bodyHtml: §14-26  Assembly of electors at state capital; time.  The electors chosen shall assemble at the state capital on the first Tuesday after the second Wednesday in December next following their election, at two o'clock in the afternoon. [L 1970, c 26, pt of §2; am L 2024, c 6, §1]
